item.summary: Raksha Rajya Mantri Shri Sanjay Seth launched the revamped Gallantry Awards portal ( https://gallantryawards.gov.in ) in New Delhi on November 12, 2026. The portal is a dedicated digital initiative to honour the courage & supreme sacrifices of the Gallantry Awardees and preserve their legacy for future generations.
item.title: Raksha Rajya Mantri launches revamped Gallantry Awards portal
